description: File a request for an object the library lacks so it gets added. Use it only after find_geometry and find_by_dimensions find nothing suitable. Each call stores one new request (calling twice files two) in the owner's private inbox; nothing else changes and nothing is published. Stored: the text, the optional contact and the time, with no IP address. Requests set the order objects are added; there is no reply unless a contact is given. At most 300 requests a day are accepted site-wide.

contact.description: Optional email or handle for a reply; include only if the person asks to be contacted.

text.description: Plain description: exact model or part number if known, what it must fit or mate with, which features matter, and any sizes already known. 3 to 4000 characters.

name: request_object
title: Request a missing object
